description: Election Commission - Mr. A. Selva Kumaran of the Kandy Municipal Council has Vacated his Office of Member of that Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Kandy Municipal Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and member status changes for a local authority, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) as it deals with the composition of an elected body under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
